description: POTENTIALLY SIGNIFICANT. Three men in olive-drab fatigues work over a large cream-colored cylindrical object mounted on a wooden A-frame cradle, lashed with rope, in a position ringed by burlap sandbags. Two of the men wear GREEN BERETS — one clearly showing a beret flash/crest — and the third wears a floppy bush hat. Below and beyond them: corrugated-tin-roofed shacks, a large rounded granite boulder at right, and beyond that a pale, hazy expanse far below the camera's elevation — consistent with looking down from considerable height onto a plain (or possibly water/sky). The cylinder bears a paper label or stencil, not resolvable. Wooden framing and a vertical post at left; green metal brackets secure the cylinder to the cradle.
